hypothesis: User-supplied link_url in notes could point to internal metadata endpoints or unverified domains, leading to SSRF or infinite redirects if passed unchecked to link resolvers.
Concurrent geocoding of large batches without per-item semaphore and hard timeout could exhaust backend connections or hang during external geocoder degradation.
LLM hallucinations outputting string numbers, null, or NaN for lat/lng could bypass validation and corrupt database decimal columns or break downstream maps.
Generic trip titles lack city anchors causing global coordinate drift, and hallucinated nested 'days' structures bypass geocoding if executed prior to flattening.
